nodes.label: PEP 517 / 660 Hooks
nodes.desc: Module-level build_wheel, build_sdist, build_editable and get_requires_for_build_* functions that every frontend calls.

nodes.label: Ouroboros Self-build
nodes.desc: The backend hatchling uses to build itself with requires = [] by re-exporting build.py and regex-parsing its own dependency list.

nodes.label: BuilderInterface
nodes.desc: Abstract builder driving every target: validates metadata, runs build hooks, dispatches version_api callables, yields artifact paths.

nodes.label: WheelBuilder
nodes.desc: PLUGIN_NAME='wheel' with standard and editable versions; writes dist-info, RECORD digests, and reproducible zip timestamps.

nodes.label: SdistBuilder
nodes.desc: PLUGIN_NAME='sdist' producing a gzip tarball with PKG-INFO and an optional legacy setup.py shim.

nodes.label: BuildHookInterface
nodes.desc: Lifecycle contract for build hooks: initialize before artifact assembly, finalize after, plus clean and finalizer options.

nodes.label: PluginManager
nodes.desc: Wraps pluggy.PluginManager('hatch'); lazily registers bundled hook modules and loads third-party 'hatch' entry points.

nodes.label: ProjectMetadata
nodes.desc: Parses PEP 621 [project] tables, resolves dynamic version via version sources, validates fields before any build.

nodes.label: click root group
nodes.desc: click group wiring 18 subcommands (build, env, run, test, publish, python, ...) and resolving the active project.

nodes.label: Application
nodes.desc: Rich-based terminal application injected into every command for styled output, prompts and aborts.

nodes.label: ProjectConfig matrix
nodes.desc: Expands [tool.hatch.envs.*.matrix] into concrete env names with itertools.product and applies override rules.

nodes.label: EnvironmentInterface
nodes.desc: Abstract environment plugin: create, remove, exists, dependency sync check and command execution life cycle.
